# Snowy pine: a trunk, three 7-sided cones, and a smaller snow cone sitting on each. Up Z.
new
add mesh cylinder --name Trunk --vertices 6 --radius 0.13 --depth 0.6 --location 0 0 0.3
material new Bark --base-color 0.349 0.118 0.216
add mesh cone --name Low --vertices 7 --radius1 0.9 --radius2 0.1 --depth 0.9 --location 0 0 0.8
material new Needles --base-color 0.345 0.667 0.678
add mesh cone --name Mid --vertices 7 --radius1 0.7 --radius2 0.05 --depth 0.8 --location 0 0 1.3 --rotation 0 0 25
material assign Needles
add mesh cone --name Tip --vertices 7 --radius1 0.45 --radius2 0 --depth 0.7 --location 0 0 1.8 --rotation 0 0 50
material assign Needles
# snow caps: the upper half of each tier, a little larger than the cone under it so it sits on top
add mesh cone --name SnowLow --vertices 7 --radius1 0.62 --radius2 0.06 --depth 0.5 --location 0 0 1.02
material new Snow --base-color 0.745 0.898 0.882
add mesh cone --name SnowMid --vertices 7 --radius1 0.48 --radius2 0.03 --depth 0.45 --location 0 0 1.5 --rotation 0 0 25
material assign Snow
add mesh cone --name SnowTip --vertices 7 --radius1 0.3 --radius2 0 --depth 0.42 --location 0 0 1.98 --rotation 0 0 50
material assign Snow
select all
shade flat
export pine.glb
